fusions.name: Trodden Toes
fusions.desc: A raking stamp that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and slows its movement by 15% for 2 seconds. You move 10% faster for 2 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Last Mile
fusions.desc: A heel strike that deals 32 damage, always crits and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 40%).

fusions.name: Marching Lungs
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 40% for 20 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Shorter Roads
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
